headlines.title: Lumentum AI optical components sold out through 2029
headlines.summary: The company cannot meet about 70% of demand for some products through next year, CEO Michael Hurlston said in Tokyo on Friday

headlines.title: Coherent Shares Rise 3.5% as Lumentum Highlights Strong AI Optical Component Demand
headlines.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) shares advanced 3. 5% in premarket trading on Friday after comments from rival Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) highlighted sustained demand for optical components used in artificial intelligence data centres, strengthening investor sentiment across the optical communications sector.

headlines.title: Lumentum Shares Rise 3.8% as AI Data Centre Demand Exceeds Optical Component Capacity
headlines.summary: Lumentum Holdings (NASDAQ:LITE) shares advanced 3. 8% in premarket trading on Friday after Chief Executive Michael Hurlston indicated that strong demand for optical components used in artificial intelligence data centres had effectively committed the company’s production capacity through early 2029.

headlines.title: New Strong Buy Stocks for October 9th
headlines.summary: LITE, HOWL, PERI, GSBD and GFF have been added to the Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) List on October 9th, 2026.

headlines.title: LITE, COHR, AAOI, POET Rise Overnight After Lumentum CEO Says Optical Parts Are ‘Completely Sold Out’ Through Early 2029
headlines.summary: AI data center demand is straining optical component supplies, according to Lumentum Holdings’ Michael Hurlston.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
